description: shortform-superengine hooks. (1) UserPromptSubmit: when the prompt contains one of the skills' trigger phrases, inject one line naming the skill to invoke instead of doing the work by hand. (2) PreToolUse on Bash: SocialCrawl credit guard, cost-gates paid API calls before they spend and hard-blocks the banned transcript endpoints. (3) PostToolUse on Skill and Read: a Skill call of angles, rehooks, hook, polarize or viral opens a slot for that session; a later Read of that skill's method file (references/legit-<name>.md, or rehooks' step3-lines.md in Step-3 mode) in the same session appends the stamp to <project>/reel-build/provenance.md for reel-scripter's gate. (4) hooks/storyboard-on-write.py. PreToolUse on Write: block creating reel-scripter's final script <project>/scripts/<slug>.md while <slug>.skeleton.md has no passed: line in provenance.md, and block writing a final script that still holds placeholders (placeholder_problems in skills/reel-scripter/structure_gate.py, a vocabulary rule: [KEYWORD], [NEEDS YOUR INPUT], [YOUR LIST], [TBD], {{keyword}}, a reel-scripter scaffold slot such as [outcome], a STATUS: DRAFT line, an INCOMPLETE marker); both route it to <slug>.draft.md. PostToolUse on Write, Edit and MultiEdit: when that final script (never *.skeleton.md or *.draft.md; it has a sibling skeleton or a ## Text overlays heading) is written, apply the not-passed rule when an Edit or MultiEdit created it, check it for placeholders, then its storyboard table and, on a problem, exit 2 with the problems on stderr so the model fixes or moves the file. PreToolUse on Bash and PowerShell records size and mtime of the active project's final scripts (one file per call in ~/.claude/shortform-superengine/script-snap/); PostToolUse on Bash and PowerShell, and PostToolUseFailure on them (a command that exits non-zero fires that instead), start through hooks/script-post.sh, which exits 0 without starting Python when the call left no snapshot, and apply the same rules to each one the call created or changed (the command is never parsed). (6) hooks/stamp-on-skill.py on UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse AskUserQuestion and PreToolUse Skill: counts user turns (a prompt or an AskUserQuestion answer) in that chat's own entry of the reel state file (one entry per chat), only when it has one (it never creates an entry), and blocks (exit 2) a shortform sub-skill call at Step 2 or later with no valid angles stamp in provenance.md, or one that moves to a higher step in the same user turn as the last call at the highest step (a checkpoint crossed without the user); both rules apply only in a session that called reel-scripter, so a sub-skill called on its own in any other session is never blocked; after a finished reel, a Step 2 call is held until the client says whether it is a new reel or a one-off, and the hold lifts only when the client's own reply asks for a one-off. After a gate pass (a passed: line, no angles stamp) a call at Step 3 or later is a fix call and passes in any session, and a Step 2 call is a new reel that needs a fresh angles stamp; so a new reel that skips Step 2 and goes straight to hook after a pass is treated as a fix call. Python hooks start through hooks/run-py.sh (py -3, then every python3 and python on PATH; the first that runs Python 3 wins; no working Python -> silent). All fail-open (any error -> allow / silent).
